card.architecture: Krea 2 RAW — aesthetic-first DiT (Qwen3-VL 4B encoder, Qwen-Image/Wan2.1 VAE); int8-ConvRot quant (bf16 is 26 GB), run on an 8 GB GPU with the weights offloaded to system RAM
card.summary: Krea's open aesthetic-first text-to-image model (RAW base variant). Tuned for polished, photographic, design-forward looks; real CFG. Runs on an 8 GB GPU as an int8-ConvRot quant with the weights spilled to system RAM. A separate distilled Turbo variant (4-8 steps) exists and is a trivial add.
use_cases: a clean base for Krea-style LoRAs
card.commercial_use: open weights — verify the Krea 2 license for your use
card.pick_when: You want Krea's polished aesthetic; runs on an 8 GB GPU via int8-ConvRot with weights offloaded to system RAM.

prompt.guidance: Descriptive natural-language prose; aesthetic/style words carry weight.
prompt.example: an editorial photograph of a ceramic vase on a sunlit table, soft film grain, muted earth tones, shallow depth of field
prompt.instructions: Write natural language; lean into style, lighting, and mood descriptors. Recommended (RAW base): ~24-32 steps, CFG ~4, euler/simple. Native ~1K. Negative prompts supported (real CFG).
do: Use a light negative if needed

speed.note: 12B-class fp8; the fp8 encoder offloads before the diffusion model loads.
speed.measured_note: Not yet benchmarked on this box.

ui_help.note: Describe what you want in plain words; style and lighting words matter most.
